PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

3. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.

4. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.

7. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

8. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

9. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

12. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Driving Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Driving Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handling Hazardous Substances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Exploration and Career Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Oblique Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
